artifact: Source code analysis of family finder group handling

criteria.criterion: A family dungeon run the finder takes in is ended as emptied while the family is inside
criteria.evidence:
The implementation in PR #1048 ensures that a family in its own finder group counts as the family's party. The tests verify that:
1. A family in its own finder group counts as the family's party (test_family_finder_party.cpp:48)
2. Outside roster members are not considered for adoption (test_dungeon_family_run_source.cpp:58)
3. Adoption census only counts the family party (test_dungeon_family_run_source.cpp:60)
4. Only family party members can trigger the client loss gate (test_dungeon_family_run_source.cpp:65)
5. Staged inside census only includes the family party (test_dungeon_family_run_source.cpp:70)
6. Guild run groups are excluded from the family party (test_family_finder_party.cpp:56-70)

This ensures that when the finder takes a family, the run is tracked as the family's party only, and when the family is inside, the run census correctly counts only them, allowing proper empty run termination.

measure.name: Family finder group adherence to party census rules
measure.baseline: Before PR #1048: Guild run groups could be part of family party, causing incorrect run termination
measure.target: After PR #1048: Only families in their own finder group count as the family's party, ensuring proper empty run tracking
measure.after: Families in their own finder group count as the family's party, guild run groups excluded, adoption census limited to family party only
